description: Ranks US banks from lowest to highest published fee for one kind of wire (outgoing or incoming, domestic or international, in dollars or foreign currency), for personal or business accounts. Pass 2 to 17 banks, or none to rank every bank covered. Banks that do not publish the fee or do not offer the wire are listed last with the reason.

account_type.description: personal (17 banks) or business (9 banks). Default personal.

banks.description: Bank names to compare, e.g. ["Chase","Wells Fargo","Ally"]. Omit to rank all covered banks.

wire_type.description: Which fee to compare: domestic_outgoing, domestic_incoming, international_outgoing_usd, international_outgoing_foreign_currency or international_incoming.

name: compare_bank_wire_fees
title: Compare wire fees across banks
